text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
After considering the track conditions<n>of the Prix
Jacques Le Marois,<n>Trainer concludes that beating
Taiki<n>there is unrealistic.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I feel a strong connection between<n>Taiki and the
Prix Jacques Le Marois,<n>so I come to the same
conclusion.<n>There's just no way I can win.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But we find another route forward!<n>We may have to
give up being the<n>first to win a European G1, but
we<n>can simply overtake Taiki in the<n>future!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The first step to accomplishing that is<n>to challenge
Taiki at the Sprinters<n>Stakes after she returns to
Japan!
